notes: v4.2 upstream-clone task. The agent gets the REAL rust-lang/regex tree (the regex-automata crate, Rust-dialect) at the parent commit, sees only the user-visible symptom (searching a one-pass DFA with MORE capture slots than the pattern compiled to panics with a slice range error instead of succeeding, e.g. 'abc' with 4 slots, or '(abc)(ABC){0}' with 6 slots), and must reproduce, localise and fix the bug in regex-automata/src/dfa/onepass.rs's slot-accounting without being told the file, function, issue number or commit (the fix commit is not reachable from the clone and there is no network). The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test (extracted from the fix commit at image build time into /opt/golden, never vendored into this task tree) plus 3 authored hidden modules (a multi-pattern one-pass DFA with a large caller slot buffer; a zero-repetition capture group amid other groups with slots sized for every group; an empty-match UTF-8 pattern with extra slots), rebuilds offline, then executes the rebuilt integration test binary DIRECTLY (never via cargo, so no wrapper/shim can fake a run), proving the binary's --list contains every relevant test, and demands explicit 'ok' lines for each required test. Review hardening: a fake /opt/cargo/bin/cargo shim printing the demanded 'ok' lines earned reward 1 on an untouched tree under the old grep-cargo-output verifier; the direct-binary verifier scores that shim 0 (both directions re-proved). The golden /opt/golden/regression.rs is byte-pinned by sha256 (matches the fix-commit blob). Provenance is enforced at the blob level (every tracked file except the one allowed source file must hash to the pinned commit's blob; no untracked non-ignored files) so a scratch file left behind, a reformat commit, or a sabotaged test file all fail. The over-fix direction is guarded: every hidden case and the upstream regression test assert exact slot contents, so a fix that clears or truncates the caller's buffer fails.
